SpectrumRecord.title: SpectrumRecord
SpectrumRecord.description: An infrared (FTIR/IR) spectrum record categorized by chemical functional group with spectral data points and peak annotations.

id.description: Unique identifier of the spectrum record.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the record owner.

userEmail.description: Email address of the spectrum author.

compoundName.description: Name of the chemical compound (e.g., Acetone, Benzoic Acid).

primaryFunctionalGroup.description: Primary chemical functional group (e.g., Alcohol, Cetonas, Ácidos Carboxílicos).

secondaryFunctionalGroups.description: Optional secondary functional groups comma-separated or JSON.

sampleState.description: Sample physical state or preparation (e.g., Líquido puro, Pastilla KBr, ATR).

instrument.description: Spectrometer model or laboratory equipment used.

notes.description: Observations, purity, experimental notes, or literature references.

fileName.description: Original uploaded file name (e.g., spectrum.jdx, sample.csv).

fileType.description: Format of the source spectrum file (jdx, csv, txt, manual).

dataPointsJson.description: JSON string containing array of [wavenumber, value] spectrum pairs.

peaksJson.description: JSON string containing detected/annotated absorption peaks with functional assignments.

/spectrums/{spectrumId}.description: Stores user IR spectra organized by chemical functional group with associated peak tables and metadata.
